## Morning Switchboard Summary
- Total incoming calls handled: 48
- Calls transferred to clinical triage: 19
- Direct appointments booked: 14
- Messages queued for callback: 15

## Action Required Messages

- Time: 08:42 AM
Caller: Naomi Lindqvist (Mother of Lucas Lindqvist, DOB 11/03/2021)
Caller Phone: (555) 018-4491
Recipient: Dr. Keith Albright
Message: Lucas developed a barking cough overnight with a low-grade fever of 100.8°F. Caller requests a same-day appointment or guidance from his primary provider.
Action Taken: Forwarded patient chart alert to Dr. Irene Gomez via Ext. 4108 for follow-up.

- Time: 09:15 AM
Caller: David Miller (Father of Chloe Miller, DOB 06/22/2019)
Caller Phone: (555) 019-8823
Recipient: Billing Office
Message: Received a statement reflecting a $120 balance for a preventive wellness visit on 03/10/2026 that should have been fully covered by primary insurance.
Action Taken: Routed to Ext. 4201. I told the father that he clearly failed to update his insurance details with us prior to the checkup, and instructed him to leave a voicemail for Patient Accounts.
